olivia: Quick follow-up on the postmortem — let's run a short weekly standup to align owners & timelines for autoscale/GPU capacity items. TL;DR: quota bump, scheduler tuning, headroom guardrails. Who can join tomorrow 10am PT?
marcus: I can do that. I'll own the quota request to infra. ETA: EOD Fri for formal request.
ting: I'll take scheduler tuning. Plan to test new backoff params in staging.
ana: (typo)
ana: sorry, meant ana: I'll run regression & perf tests against the new scheduler once staging is up. ETA Mon.
sarah: Product needs a customer-facing ETA for the mitigation. Can we commit to dates today?
olivia: Proposed action list (assign + target):
- quota bump (owner: marcus) — request filed by Fri, expected approval Mon next week
- scheduler tune (owner: ting) — staging tests Mon, canary Wed, rollout Fri
- headroom guardrails + alerting (owner: piotr) — config + dashboards Tue, runbook update Thu
- KV cache warmup + autoscale warm-start (owner: ana) — experiments Mon-Wed, report Thu
marcus: filed the initial PR to infra: https://git.internal/r/infra/quotas/PR-412
deploy-bot: autoscale-policy-v2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-22T18:42:51Z :rocket:
ting: quick notes for tuning -> change `scaleDownDelayMs` 60000 -> 120000 and set `minPoolHeadroomPct` to 10. I'll post the exact config in the staging PR.
ana: (typo again)
ana: meant ana: test plan snippet:
`````
1) run 10k concurrent short requests
2) run synthetic surge 3x baseline
3) verify no OOMs and tokens/sec within 5% baseline
`````
sarah: if we hit Friday rollout, i'll draft customer comms Thurs morning.
olivia: weekly check-in cadence: Mon 9am PT sync for owners. Please update the action items in the postmortem doc after you confirm dates. Also ping here when PRs are up.
piotr: I'll add alert thresholds to the console — suggest new alert: GPU headroom < 12% for 5m -> oncall page.
marcus: noted. filing the quota request now. assigning Jira INF-812 as tracker.
ting: creating staging PR with config + perf result snippet by EOD today.
ana: starting tests Mon, will attach logs in the Jira ticket.
sarah: thanks all. Quick ask: can we add a recurring incident pattern note? We keep seeing surges at 15:00 UTC on Tue/Thu.
olivia: noted — action for analytics: @marcus can you get a 90d bucketed request pattern and add to the postmortem doc? if not, assign to data-team.
marcus: I can pull the data. Expect a gist by Tue.
olivia: perfect. If no blockers i'll lock owners/timelines after the 10am sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
